STEP 7 - Energy:
- Leaves: 83 g x 20 kcal/100 g = 17 kcal
- Breaded fish/chicken: 176 g x 220 kcal/100 g = 387 kcal (breading and frying add fat)
- Roasted vegetables: 126 g x 90 kcal/100 g = 113 kcal (eggplant and potato cooked in oil)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 385 g and ≈ 517 kcal. This fits a fully covered dinner plate of a substantial salad with a fried protein and roasted vegetables. The estimate is plausible.
